component.name: Sheet
component.script:
sub init() m.th = LumenTheme() m.top.visible = false m.dim = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") m.dim.id = "sheetDim" m.dim.width = 1920 m.dim.height = 1080 m.panel = m.top.createChild("Group") m.panel.id = "sheetPanel" m.panelX = 1920 - 40 - 600 bg = m.panel.createChild("Poster") bg.uri = "pkg:/images/ui/sheet_r44.9.png" bg.blendColor = m.th.paper bg.width = 600 bg.height = 1000 m.titleL = m.panel.createChild("Label") m.titleL.font = LumenFont("Fraunces-Title", 48) m.titleL.color = m.th.ink m.titleL.translation = [44, 44] m.titleL.width = 520 m.titleL.height = 60 m.subL = m.panel.createChild("Label") m.subL.font = LumenFont("Manrope-Bold", 22) m.subL.color = m.th.ink60 m.subL.translation = [46, 108] m.subL.width = 520 m.subL.height = 30 m.list = m.panel.createChild("Group") m.list.translation = [24, 170] m.picking = invalid m.index = 0
m.anim = m.top.createChild("Animation") m.anim.duration = 0.26 m.anim.easeFunction = "outQuad" m.dimIn = m.anim.createChild("FloatFieldInterpolator") m.dimIn.fieldToInterp = "sheetDim.opacity" m.dimIn.key = [0, 1] m.slide = m.anim.createChild("Vector2DFieldInterpolator") m.slide.fieldToInterp = "sheetPanel.translation" m.slide.key = [0, 1] m.fadeP = m.anim.createChild("FloatFieldInterpolator") m.fadeP.fieldToInterp = "sheetPanel.opacity" m.fadeP.key = [0, 1] m.anim.observeField("state", "onAnimState") end sub
sub onTitle() m.titleL.text = m.top.title m.subL.text = m.top.subtitle end sub
sub onDeep() m.dim.color = WithAlpha(m.top.deep, 0.45) end sub
sub build() m.list.removeChildrenIndex(m.list.getChildCount(), 0) m.items = [] rows = m.top.rows for i = 0 to rows.Count() - 1 r = rows[i] g = m.list.createChild("Group") g.translation = [0, i * 92] bg = g.createChild("Poster") bg.uri = "pkg:/images/ui/card_r28.9.png" bg.width = 552 bg.height = 84 l = g.createChild("Label") l.font = LumenFont("Manrope-Bold", 28) l.translation = [24, 0] l.width = 300 l.height = 84 l.vertAlign = "center" l.text = r.label v = g.createChild("Label") v.font = LumenFont("Manrope-ExtraBold", 24) v.horizAlign = "right" v.translation = [230, 0] v.width = 300 v.height = 84 v.vertAlign = "center" m.items.Push({ bg: bg, label: l, value: v, row: r, choice: indexOfValue(r) }) end for if m.index >= m.items.Count() then m.index = 0 paintRows() end sub
function indexOfValue(r as object) as integer if r.choices = invalid then return -1 for i = 0 to r.choices.Count() - 1 if r.choices[i].value = r.value then return i end for return 0 end function
sub paintRows() for i = 0 to m.items.Count() - 1 it = m.items[i] f = (i = m.index) if it.choice >= 0 it.value.text = it.row.choices[it.choice].label + " ›" else if it.row.note <> invalid it.value.text = it.row.note else it.value.text = "" end if if f it.bg.blendColor = m.th.ink it.bg.opacity = 1 it.label.color = m.th.white it.value.color = m.th.white else it.bg.blendColor = m.th.ink it.bg.opacity = 0.05 it.label.color = m.th.ink it.value.color = m.th.ink60 end if end for end sub
sub onOpen() m.anim.control = "stop" if m.top.open m.top.visible = true m.picking = invalid m.index = 0 paintRows() m.dimIn.keyValue = [0, 1] m.slide.keyValue = [[m.panelX + 60, 40], [m.panelX, 40]] m.fadeP.keyValue = [0, 1] else m.dimIn.keyValue = [1, 0] m.slide.keyValue = [[m.panelX, 40], [m.panelX + 60, 40]] m.fadeP.keyValue = [1, 0] end if m.anim.control = "start" end sub
sub onAnimState() if m.anim.state = "stopped" and not m.top.open then m.top.visible = false end sub
' Returns false only for Back on the main list, so MainScene closes the sheet. function handleKey(key as string) as boolean if key = "back" if m.picking = invalid then return false leaveOptions() return true end if if m.items = invalid or m.items.Count() = 0 then return true if key = "up" and m.index > 0 m.index = m.index - 1 else if key = "down" and m.index < m.items.Count() - 1 m.index = m.index + 1 else if key = "OK" it = m.items[m.index] if m.picking <> invalid ' An option was chosen: apply it to the parent row and go back. p = m.picking p.item.choice = m.index m.top.changed = { id: p.item.row.id, value: p.item.row.choices[m.index].value } leaveOptions() return true else if it.choice >= 0 enterOptions(it) return true end if v = invalid if it.row.value <> invalid then v = it.row.value m.top.chosen = { id: it.row.id, value: v } end if paintRows() return true end function
' The options of one row, shown as their own list in the same sheet. sub enterOptions(it as object) saved = { item: it, index: m.index, items: m.items, title: m.titleL.text, sub: m.subL.text } rows = [] for i = 0 to it.row.choices.Count() - 1 note = "" if i = it.choice then note = "Selected" rows.Push({ id: "option", label: it.row.choices[i].label, note: note }) end for m.titleL.text = it.row.label m.subL.text = "OK to choose · Back to return" m.top.rows = rows m.picking = saved m.index = it.choice paintRows() end sub
sub leaveOptions() p = m.picking m.picking = invalid ' Rebuild the main list from the remembered rows, keeping the updated choice. rows = [] for each old in p.items r = old.row if old.choice >= 0 then r.value = r.choices[old.choice].value rows.Push(r) end for m.titleL.text = p.title m.subL.text = p.sub m.top.rows = rows m.index = p.index paintRows() end sub
